The '''X-X landspeeder''' was a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] manufactured by [[ZZip Product Concepts Limited]] around the time of the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] ''[[Silver Speeder]]'' was a modified X-X.
